title: Bahia web routes render without runtime console errors
observed_behavior: A Playwright MCP route sweep initially produced bootstrap-discovery console errors when the ad hoc MCP harness emitted EOSE without scoped discovery EVENTs.
After correcting the MCP harness to deliver stored discovery EVENTs before EOSE, representative routes rendered without app console/page errors.

The new Playwright regression initially exposed a deterministic DNS route harness gap: /dns fetched NIP-11 metadata for ws://relay.test.local and Chromium logged Failed to load resource: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED.
intended_behavior: Every representative Bahia dashboard route should render under deterministic Nostr and REST E2E harnesses without uncaught page errors or unexpected console errors.
Nostr bootstrap discovery in the harness must preserve event-stream semantics by delivering scoped EVENT messages before EOSE.
Routes that perform relay capability discovery must receive deterministic NIP-11 metadata responses in tests instead of relying on external DNS or network availability.

included: deterministic NIP-11 metadata fulfillment for the test relay
excluded: Changing production DNS or relay subscription semantics
